fusions.name: Threshing Sweep
fusions.desc: Flails through a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 11 damage to everything in it with a 40% chance to leave each [Weakened] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Stripped Bare
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full 6-tile reach, with a 50% chance to leave the target [Sundered] for 6 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Cloud on the Floor
fusions.desc: Releases a swarm for 8 seconds that strikes the nearest enemy within 4 tiles every second for 3 damage.

fusions.name: Gorged
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
